regions.title: World
regions.sources: Al Jazeera, AOL/Yahoo News, Democracy Now!, SBS News, Xinhua, Dawn

stories.h: Trump: 'blow 'em up or make a deal' with Iran
stories.s: Asked about talks with Tehran in the Oval Office, Trump said the US faces a choice between strikes and a deal, adding that 'the time is coming'.
stories.src: AOL/Yahoo News; Al Jazeera · 30 Sep–1 Oct 2026

stories.h: Putin vows 'all weapons' to defend Kaliningrad
stories.s: At Valdai he warned NATO over the exclave and ruled out halting Black Sea strikes, but is open to talks with Trump and Xi.

stories.h: Cockpit stabbing forces Flydubai jet to divert
stories.s: Dubai–Tel Aviv flight FZ1073 landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a crew member allegedly attacked a pilot. Both pilots were injured.
stories.src: Al Jazeera; Democracy Now! · 30 Sep–1 Oct 2026

stories.h: South Korea's exports hit record $120.9bn
stories.s: September shipments rose 83.5% year on year as AI demand drove chip exports up 262.8% to $60.3bn.

stories.h: Gaza mourners bury 105 recovered from rubble
stories.s: A mass funeral in Gaza City included 60 children. Medics reported further deaths from Israeli strikes on Wednesday.

regions.title: Asia
regions.sources: Xinhua, Al Jazeera, Geo News, Dawn, The Daily Star (AFP), CPJ, SCMP

stories.h: South Korea posts record exports on AI chips
stories.s: September exports hit $120.94bn, up 83.5%, with a record $49.85bn trade surplus.

stories.h: Pakistan strikes militant hideouts in Afghanistan
stories.s: Islamabad says 'calibrated' air strikes at two locations killed at least 22 fighters.
stories.src: Geo News; Dawn; Al Jazeera · 1 Oct 2026

stories.h: India's opposition calls 'vote theft' protests
stories.s: Congress chief Kharge announced a march on the Election Commission over a voter-roll revision.

stories.h: Hong Kong journalist held on sedition charge
stories.s: Tang Ho-wing of Boom News was arrested over coverage of a 2019 clash anniversary.

stories.h: Xi strikes confident note on National Day
stories.s: Marking the PRC's 77th anniversary, Xi rallied the country behind growth and tech resilience.

regions.title: Africa
regions.sources: France 24, Rio Times, News24, IOL, Al Jazeera

stories.h: Ethiopia and Eritrea break diplomatic ties
stories.s: Addis Ababa expelled 10 Eritrean diplomats and shut its Asmara embassy; Eritrea cut all ties.

stories.h: 52 civilians killed in Tigray fighting
stories.s: Three days of clashes around Alamata left over 700 wounded as troops push north.

stories.h: Helicopter crash kills Zimbabwe's Chivayo
stories.s: Businessman Wicknell Chivayo, his wife and four others died near Marondera; bad weather blamed.

stories.h: DR Congo buries official who defended Ebola effort
stories.s: Marie-Celestin Karondwa died after being beaten at his home in Butembo, an Ebola hotspot.

stories.h: Tinubu marks Independence Day with reform claim
stories.s: Nigeria's president cited 4% growth and over $6bn in non-oil exports in his 1 October speech.

regions.title: North America
regions.sources: Al Jazeera, CBS News, Mexico News Daily, US Treasury, Rio Times

stories.h: Canada fast-tracks Pacific oil pipeline
stories.s: Carney named the 1m-barrel-a-day Pacific Link line a project of national interest to cut US reliance.

stories.h: Polo's remnants put 100m Americans on flood alert
stories.s: After landfalls in Baja California Sur and Sonora, the storm's moisture threatens nine US states.
stories.src: CBS News; Mexico News Daily · 30 Sep 2026

stories.h: US sanctions Sinaloa Cartel network
stories.s: Treasury listed 21 people and 25 entities, including the ex-husband of Baja California's governor.
stories.src: US Treasury; Rio Times · 29 Sep–1 Oct 2026

stories.h: Mexico's exports jump 40.4% in August
stories.s: Shipments reached about US$78bn as electronics exports more than doubled.

stories.h: OpenAI reviews reported hack bid on Canada
stories.s: The company is examining a report of a failed attack targeting Canada's national archives agency.

stories.h: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied before vote
stories.s: A Quaest runoff poll shows 42–42 ahead of Sunday's first round in Brazil.
stories.src: Rio Times; Al Jazeera · 30 Sep–1 Oct 2026

stories.h: Colombia's central bank surprises with rate hike
stories.s: The rate rose 25 basis points to 12.25% as unemployment climbed to 9.4%.

stories.h: Chile's jobless rate hits highest since 2021
stories.s: Unemployment reached 9.6% while copper output fell 12.8% to a 15-year low.

stories.h: Argentina court lifts foreign land limits
stories.s: The Supreme Court cleared Milei's decree, as he visits Paris for investment talks.

stories.h: UK rejects Argentina's Falklands arbitration
stories.s: London questioned Buenos Aires' reliability as a partner over the Sea Lion oil project.

regions.title: Antarctica
regions.note: Fewer than five Antarctic stories in 24 h, so the window is extended to 21 days; each story is dated.
regions.sources: NSIDC (via UA News), Copernicus Marine (via AFP/Dawn), ABC News, Copernicus/NetNewsLedger, The Conversation

stories.h: Sea ice maximum confirmed third-lowest
stories.s: Winter extent peaked at about 17.59m km² on 14 Sep; the four lowest maxima are all from the last four years.

stories.h: Report: polar oceans transformed by warming
stories.s: Copernicus warns most emperor penguin colonies could near extinction by 2100.
stories.src: Copernicus Marine via AFP; Dawn · 30 Sep–1 Oct 2026

stories.h: China plans sixth Antarctic research base
stories.s: The Marie Byrd Land station, due to start next year, has stirred debate in Australia.

stories.h: Ozone hole grows larger than usual
stories.s: It reached about 25m km² by 12 Sep, roughly 5m km² above normal for the date.

stories.h: Study: Antarctic ice loss now locked in
stories.s: Researchers say extra snowfall will not offset losses, raising risks for low-lying coasts.

regions.title: Europe
regions.sources: SBS News, Al Jazeera, Euronews, AOL (AP), Dawn

stories.h: Putin warns West over Kaliningrad
stories.s: He said Russia would use 'all the weapons' at its disposal if the exclave were attacked.

stories.h: Burnham sees Iran role in RAF Fairford scare
stories.s: The UK PM cited 'strong indications'; police found petrol, not explosives. Iran denies it.

stories.h: Russian drone hits Kyiv school and bridge
stories.s: Children sheltered as the school was struck; the bridge hit halted metro services.

stories.h: French school protests spread; 440 arrested
stories.s: Students blocked about 400 schools over crowded classes and staff shortages.

stories.h: Norway probes 11 officials over Epstein links
stories.s: Parliament is examining ties between Epstein and senior political and diplomatic figures.

stories.h: RBA flags AI and bonds as top risks
stories.s: The Reserve Bank is more worried by overseas threats than the housing downturn.

stories.h: Victorian doctors set for mass walkout
stories.s: Public hospital doctors will strike for four hours after 14 months of pay talks.

stories.h: SA Royal Commission into AI gets underway
stories.s: Three experts will lead the inquiry into AI's impact on jobs and the workforce.

stories.h: Mistaken-identity shootings rattle Sydney
stories.s: Western Sydney residents voice fear after people were caught in gang crossfire.

stories.h: Chris Fagan quits Brisbane Lions
stories.s: The coach steps down days after winning a third straight AFL premiership.

regions.title: United States
regions.sources: Al Jazeera, Democracy Now!, CBC, Air & Space Forces Magazine, The Hill (AP-NORC)

stories.h: Tennessee halts executions after botched one
stories.s: Christa Pike survived two lethal injections; Gov. Bill Lee paused the rest of 2026's executions.
stories.src: Democracy Now!; Al Jazeera · 30 Sep–1 Oct 2026

stories.h: Hegseth cuts 20% of generals, adds drone command
stories.s: His 'State of the Force' speech created a new command for autonomous warfare.
stories.src: CBC; Air & Space Forces Mag. · 30 Sep 2026

stories.h: Supreme Court to rule on ICE detention policy
stories.s: Justices will decide if migrants can be held in mandatory detention without bond.

stories.h: Most Americans say Iran war not worth it
stories.s: An AP-NORC survey finds about two-thirds oppose the US-Israeli campaign.

stories.h: Pennsylvania confirms fifth measles death
stories.s: US cases have more than doubled since August as the outbreak grows.

stories.h: Air strikes hit militant hideouts in Afghanistan
stories.s: The information ministry says strikes at two sites killed at least 22 militants.
stories.src: Dawn; Geo News; Al Jazeera · 1 Oct 2026

stories.h: Emergency in KP 'seriously considered'
stories.s: A federal minister said so as PTI refused to delay its 4 October march.

stories.h: FBR beats first-quarter tax target
stories.s: Strong sales tax receipts drove the result; the return deadline moves to 15 Oct.

stories.h: Govt works to bring tanker sailors home
stories.s: Three Pakistanis died on the hijacked Honour 25; injured crew are treated in Puntland.

stories.h: Pakistan reach Asian Games cricket final
stories.s: A rain-hit six-wicket win over Bangladesh; volleyball team beat India 3-0.
